description.text:
Grants Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user, grants Quick ATB 2 to user & Ursula if Ursula is in party
Tactical Awoken Mode: Earth Ability Boost, Triplecast Earth, Unlimited Earth Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Earth Abilities, Earth Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Earth Abilities; Ends after using 8 Earth abilities
TP Max: AOE Earth/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1
